title: Djinn of Rituals: Their Own Rituals (lore build)
summary: The Djinns of Rituals are Ritual tributes with no Ritual of their own, so this list pairs them with the Rituals of their own sets. Divine Grace - Northwemko came out in Stardust Overdrive with Presider and Releaser. Garlandolf, King of Destruction came out in Absolute Powerforce with Cursenchanter, Disserere and Prognosticator. Forbidden Ritual Art (2026) is here because Djinn Releaser appears in its art. The Djinn of the Rituals page opens this same list.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: The legal Djinns: Presider, Cursenchanter, Disserere, Prognosticator and Demolisher. Djinn Releaser of Rituals is Forbidden.
Divine Grace - Northwemko and Ritual of Grace, from Stardust Overdrive.
Garlandolf, King of Destruction and Ritual of Destruction, from Absolute Powerforce.
Forbidden Ritual Art, the newest card.

summary.title: How it plays
points: Each Djinn can be banished from the GY as one of a Ritual Summon's tributes, and gives the Ritual Monster its effect. Demolisher stops targeting, Disserere stops Traps, Cursenchanter negates Synchros, Presider draws on a kill and Prognosticator discards on a hit.
Djinns reach the GY by being tributed from the hand for the first Ritual, so later Rituals cost only Djinns from the GY.
Garlandolf destroys every face-up monster with DEF at or below its ATK when Ritual Summoned. Northwemko can't be destroyed by effects while the cards it picks stay on the field.
Forbidden Ritual Art Ritual Summons a Ritual Monster from the GY by banishing monsters, such as spent Djinns, as the tribute.

main: As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster can't be targeted by them.
As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster draws on each kill.
As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster negates Synchro Monsters.
As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster is unaffected by Traps.
As GY tribute, its Ritual Monster makes them discard on a hit.

Level 7 Ritual: can't be destroyed by effects while its picked cards stay.
Ritual Spell for Northwemko; banishes to protect a Ritual Monster.
